observations: Photo 0: Blue motorcycle with front headlight, front fork, and visible front fender; front plate/number area is present but not clearly readable.
Photo 0: Side panel shows text that appears to include 'X100' (not fully clear).
Photo 1: Blue motorcycle from the side; seat and engine area visible; rear cargo/guard rack present.
Photo 1: Rear license plate is visible but the exact characters are not clearly readable.
Photo 2: Rear view shows tail light and a rear rack/guard; license plate is visible but not clearly readable.

identity.kind: motorcycle (small commuter/super cub style, appears like 100cc class)

claims.claim: Lately used by giveaway [price hidden]% okay buy and drive to any location with battery everything...
claims.evidence: Photos show a motorcycle, but do not confirm battery condition, whether it starts/runs, or that it can be driven to any location.
No purchase date, receipt, or odometer/registration document is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show brake performance, gear condition, or originality; rust status is only partially assessable from limited angles.

risks.risk: Engine/battery may not actually be in good working condition (seller says 'buy and drive', but photos can’t confirm starting/running).
risks.proof: Short video clip of a cold start + 2–3 minutes idling + brief ride showing smooth gear changes and no warning lights.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as needing inspection/possible minor repairs).

risks.risk: Brake effectiveness and clutch/gear engagement may be weak or failing under load.
risks.proof: Video clip: rider applies front and rear brakes at low speed (showing stopping power) and demonstrates gear shifts without slipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes/gears not guaranteed perfect.

risks.risk: Rust/hidden corrosion or frame/engine wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain/sprocket area, brake discs/drums, engine casing, and underside/frame + a quick wipe test showing surface condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible wear consistent with used commuter bikes.

risks.risk: Model/engine capacity may be misrepresented (photos suggest 'X100' text but not fully readable).
risks.proof: Photo of the engine number/model stamp and a clear shot of the bike’s model badge/side panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for the closest matching commuter class.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the model/badge text and the engine number/model stamp (so we confirm exact capacity/model).
Send a short video: cold start, then a short ride showing gear changes and both brakes working well.
Send close-ups of chain/sprocket, brake area (front and rear), and underside/frame for rust/corrosion check.
Send odometer reading and any receipt/registration date to support 'bought new 6 months ago'.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a small commuter-style motorcycle in used condition, but key claims (starts/runs, brake/gear perfection, originality, purchase date) are not provable remotely. So I price it at the worst-case within the provided comparables for the closest matching category.
